title: Gideon and the Archive
author: Paloma Thornbury
blurb: Xanthe Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
